cash_breakdown.item: Cash at banks and in hand
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Group cash is not split by listed parent, operating subsidiaries and regulated capital; ordinary operating subsidiary cash default haircut applied.
cash_breakdown.reason: Bank cash is potentially distributable or usable for debt repayment after preserving operating and regulatory cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Short-term bank deposits default to 0.80-0.95, reduced because group-level ownership and regulatory capital split is not disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Short-term deposits are liquid but not proven to sit at the listed parent.

cash_breakdown.item: Investments in money market instruments included in cash equivalents
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Although classified as cash equivalents, the annual report says management considered significant influence and recognized them as FVTPL; treated closer to fund/structured cash with redemption and business-support uncertainty.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially liquid self-owned money market exposure, but not equivalent to unrestricted bank cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Broker deposits may be margin or operating settlement balances; rights and restrictions are not disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: No deduction as detachable cash without proof that it can be freely distributed.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Listed equity, debt and listed funds are saleable but market risk, product seed-capital function and tax/friction risks remain.
cash_breakdown.reason: Could be monetized over time without necessarily stopping the asset-management platform.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Default 0.00-0.40 for unlisted funds/long-term investments; much of the exposure is seed capital or interests in funds managed/advised by the group.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially monetizable only with time and at uncertain discounts; may support AUM and product track record.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Real-estate joint venture interests are illiquid and not ordinary cash; low investment-asset haircut used.
cash_breakdown.reason: May be separable from the fee-management platform but cannot be treated as near cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Investment property default 0.00-0.50; this property is in the Real Estate Partnership and pledged for borrowing.
cash_breakdown.reason: Asset can theoretically be sold, but pledged debt and property-market execution risk require a low factor.

cash_breakdown.item: Bank borrowing secured by investment property
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Interest-bearing bank borrowing is deducted at 100%.
cash_breakdown.reason: The borrowing is secured by the New Zealand investment property and must be netted against detachable investment assets.

cash_breakdown.item: Necessary operating and regulatory cash reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Asset manager needs working cash for compensation, distribution channels, professional costs and regulated entity capital; exact split is not disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Conservative reserve approximates several months of ordinary cash expenses and capital buffer.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX, redemption and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Cross-currency assets, fund redemptions, taxable disposals and upstream dividend friction are not fully disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Explicit friction reserve avoids counting gross investment values as fully removable cash.

profit_quality.assessment: 2025 reported profit is not a clean recurring cash-profit base. The year included HK$374.3 million gross performance fees, HK$370.362 million net gains on investments, HK$96.252 million share of gains of joint ventures and HK$28.131 million FX gains. Operating cash flow was only HK$42.424 million because fees receivable increased by HK$375.545 million. The main sortable denominator therefore uses the 2023-2025 parent-net-profit median of HK$31.235 million, then applies a 0.30 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Do not use 2025 reported parent net profit of HK$667.698 million as sustainable cash profit.
Treat performance fees and investment/FX/JV gains as volatile or non-core for owner earnback.
Use 2023-2025 parent net profit median HK$31.235 million as pre-haircut sustainable cash-profit proxy.
Apply 0.30 haircut due to weak recurring management-fee profitability and poor 2025 operating cash conversion.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2023 operating cash flow was HK$56.325 million, 2024 was -HK$2.094 million and 2025 was HK$42.424 million; 2025 operating cash flow was far below reported profit.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Profit largely depends on performance fees and investment marks; fee receivable growth absorbed cash in 2025.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Weak in 2025: operating cash flow / reported parent net profit was about 6.35%.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Reported purchase of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets was HK$3.005 million in 2025; capex is small relative to staff and distribution economics.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Fee receivables increased by HK$375.545 million in the 2025 cash-flow reconciliation, showing material cash delay despite reported profit.
